description:
First Piko Plus release, based on piko 3.11.1-dev.

### Added
- **Conversation notifications** for Instagram DMs: Android conversation-style notifications with history, sender names and avatars, inline reply, mark as read and share-sheet shortcuts.
- **Custom emoji font**: download Apple, Google Noto, Twemoji or Microsoft Fluent emoji from Piko settings > Font.
- **Material You, extended**: system Settings colours (Material 3 roles on Android 14+), Compose screens, secondary buttons, story rings, note bubbles and dark-mode surfaces.
